original_tile.description: A large storage vase with a decorative slip. The style hints that it was fired in the home-kiln of a canyon dweller.

source_features: Large rounded pottery bowl, long narrow neck, flared open mouth and two side loop handles. Source detail rows14 and16 define two decorative slip bands.

native_behavior.scope: Native liquid storage, randomized slip color and pottery behavior remain native. No new state or fill simulation.

palette.detail: g default decorative slip; RandomColors detail all remains native
palette.rule: Neutral material and independent slip ownership; do not bake donor white or the default detail green.

donor_reference.role: Actual Urn.png supplies restrained pottery shading and open-rim/edge convention only. Keep the Qud long neck, pair of handles and two slip bands.

authored_interpretation: A complete hollow lathed pottery wall, joined two handles and two circumferential slip bands. Hidden depth, wall thickness, smoothed contours and shallow camera elevation are authored.

per_view_contract.production: One original fixed map view: both symmetric handles connect neck to shoulder; two slip bands remain on bowl; visible open rim.
per_view_contract.diagnostic: Angled actual model shows hollow mouth, handle depth and continuation of both decorative rings.
per_view_contract.scale: One16x24 source cell ->512x768 manual ->256square recipient. Anchor8,16; no alpha-bound sizing.

states: One fixed native tile. RandomColors changes palette and liquid filling changes contents, not evidence of extra exterior geometry or a directional family.
